subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling tech deep dive for Acme Analytics

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-12T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling tech deep dive for Acme Analytics

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for your time earlier — great to learn more about Acme's platform and the latency/cost pain you mentioned around embedding-based search. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: you run a high-traffic search service for product content (avg. seq len ~300 tokens). You're most interested in reducing per-query token cost and tightening 95th percentile latency.
- What we'd like to do next: 1) technical deep dive demo of Redwood inference (KV/prefix caching, batching, quantization profiles) with your infra team; 2) a short evaluation plan for a proof-of-concept.

Would next week work for a 45–60 minute technical deep dive? Here are a few slots I have open (PT):
- Wed, Feb 18 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Wed, Feb 18 — 2:00–3:00 PM PT
- Thu, Feb 19 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, share 2–3 times that are better and I’ll align. Also: who should join from your side (SRE, infra, ML infra)? Rafael (solutions engineer) will join from our side; I can loop in Marissa (CS) if you’d like renewal/ops context.

Attaching a short PDF with my notes from today's discovery.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of call)
